label: mutation-omitted-window
command:
import hashlib, subprocess
from pathlib import Path
path = Path("backend/src/incident_copilot/agents/tool_loop.py")
original = path.read_bytes()
source = original.decode()
old = "result = await tool.ainvoke(call.get(\"args\", {}), config=tool_config)"
assert source.count(old) == 1
try:
    path.write_text(source.replace(old, "result = await tool.ainvoke(call.get(\"args\", {}))"))
    result = subprocess.run([".venv/bin/pytest", "backend/tests/unit/agents/test_temporal_boundaries.py", "-vv", "-k", "test_service_window_matches"], timeout=20)
    assert result.returncode == 1, result.returncode
finally:
    path.write_bytes(original)
    assert hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).digest() == hashlib.sha256(original).digest()
print("Expected regression failures observed; original source restored exactly.")

label: review-audit
command:
import json, re, subprocess
from pathlib import Path
root = Path.cwd()
directory = root / "docs/validation/2026-10-23-temporal-boundaries"
test = root / "backend/tests/unit/agents/test_temporal_boundaries.py"
records = [json.loads(line) for line in (directory / "checks.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()]
assert len({record["label"] for record in records}) == len(records)
timeouts = {"focused-initial", "probe-sandbox", "full-test-sandbox"}
for record in records:
    log = directory / (record["label"] + ".log")
    assert log.is_file() and log.stat().st_size
    assert record["environment_keys"] == ["PATH"]
    assert record["timed_out"] == (record["label"] in timeouts)
    assert record["exit_code"] == (-9 if record["label"] in timeouts else 0)
for label, count in [("mutation-omitted-window", 6), ("mutation-spoofed-config", 4), ("mutation-report-metadata", 6), ("mutation-invalid-fallback", 8)]:
    log = (directory / (label + ".log")).read_text()
    assert re.search(r"=+ " + str(count) + r" failed,", log)
    assert "original source restored exactly" in log
assert "552 passed" in (directory / "full-test-host.log").read_text()
links = re.findall(r"\]\(([^)]+)\)", (directory / "README.md").read_text())
for link in links:
    if "://" not in link:
        assert (directory / link.split("#")[0]).resolve().exists(), link
subprocess.run(["git", "diff", "--exit-code", "--", "backend/src"], check=True)
subprocess.run(["git", "diff", "--check"], check=True)
ignored = subprocess.check_output(["git", "check-ignore", "REFACTORING_PLAN.md", ".env"], text=True).splitlines()
assert ignored == ["REFACTORING_PLAN.md", ".env"]
allowed = {str(test.relative_to(root))}
for file in subprocess.check_output(["git", "ls-files", "--others", "--exclude-standard"], text=True).splitlines():
    assert file in allowed or file.startswith(str(directory.relative_to(root)) + "/"), file
for file in [test, *directory.iterdir()]:
    if file.is_file():
        content = file.read_text()
        assert not re.search(r"sk-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}|AKIA[A-Z0-9]{16}|-----BEGIN (?:RSA |EC |OPENSSH )?PRIVATE KEY", content), file.name
print(f"Verified {len(records)} retained command records, 24 deliberate mutation failures, local links, private ignores, scope, credential patterns, and unchanged application source.")
